_what: Every merged PR that triggers a rule requiring an ADR, replayed through main's gate and this branch's. The corpus is the PR BODY, which is not the commit message an earlier measurement used.
_why_committed: The CRLF corpus was committed so the measurement and the gate see the same thing. The argument for cutting the citation deserves the same standard: a seat pointed out that it rested on a replay nobody else could re-run.
